summary: Iteration 3 backend-only testing of the AWS_REGION normalization fix in backend/storage.py. Added /app/backend/tests/test_storage_region.py (11 tests) covering all 7 requested _clean_region cases, fresh importlib.reload with AWS_REGION='US East (N. Virginia) us-east-1' (module _REGION resolves to 'us-east-1'), init_storage() RuntimeError containing 'S3_BUCKET_NAME' with no bucket configured, and public_url fallback. Re-ran the full previous suite as regression. Result: 46/46 passed (35 prior regression tests + 11 new), 0 failures. No API endpoints hit S3; backend not restarted.

minor.issue: Regex [a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d+ mis-parses 4-segment AWS regions: 'us-gov-west-1' -> 'ov-west-1' and 'US GovCloud (US-West) us-gov-west-1' -> 'ov-west-1' (invalid region, boto3 would fail). Suggest r'\b[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+)?-\d+\b'. Not blocking for the reported us-east-1 case.

On no regex match the raw string is returned verbatim (e.g. 'garbage-value'), so a truly bad AWS_REGION still reaches boto3 and reproduces the original 'doesn't match a supported format' warning instead of falling back to 'us-east-1'. Consider falling back to the default + logging a warning.

action_items: Optional hardening: broaden _clean_region regex to support 4-segment regions (us-gov-west-1) and fall back to 'us-east-1' when no valid region code is found.
critical_code_review_comments: _REGION/_BUCKET/_ENDPOINT are read at import time only; env changes require a process restart (acceptable for Railway, but init_storage(force=True) currently ignores the force flag and cached _client is never reset).

init_storage() failure is swallowed by a warning in server.py:1351 — uploads will fail later at request time with a raw boto error; consider surfacing a clear 503 for media endpoints when storage is unconfigured.
seed_data_creation: None new; existing suite self-seeds test_*@example.com users and cleans up via session fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/ and is green (46 tests, ~53s). New file test_storage_region.py reloads the storage module via importlib with monkeypatched env and always reloads back to the original state in a finally block — keep that pattern to avoid leaking env into other tests. S3 head_bucket path is intentionally untested (no real credentials).
rca_of_the_issue: Railway env var AWS_REGION was set to the AWS console display label 'US East (N. Virginia) us-east-1'; boto3 rejects non-conforming region_name, so init_storage logged 'Storage init skipped'. The _clean_region() regex extraction now normalizes the label to 'us-east-1' at module import; verified by fresh importlib.reload test. Residual gap: unmatched/4-segment inputs are not normalized (see minor issues).
